lines.gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਜੇਵ ਸਾਇਰ ਦੇਇ ਲਹਰੀ ਬਿਜੁਲ ਜਿਵੈ ਚਮਕਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: ohu jev saair dei laharee bijul jivai chamakae ||
lines.translation: It is temporary, like the waves on the sea, and the flash of lightning.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਾਝੁ ਰਾਖਾ ਕੋਇ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੋਇ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har baajh raakhaa koi naahee soi tujhahi bisaariaa ||
lines.translation: Without the Lord, there is no other protector, but you have forgotten Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਚੇਤਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਰਹਿ ਹਰਣਾ ਕਾਲਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sach kahai naanak chet re man marahi haranaa kaaliaa ||1||
lines.translation: Nanak speaks the Truth. Reflect upon it, O mind; you shall die, O black deer. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਵਰਾ ਫੂਲਿ ਭਵੰਤਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhavaraa phool bhava(n)tiaa dukh at bhaaree raam ||
lines.translation: O bumble bee, you wander among the flowers, but terrible pain awaits you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਛਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai gur poochhiaa aapanaa saachaa beechaaree raam ||
lines.translation: I have asked my Guru for true understanding.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੁਝੈ ਪੂਛਿਆ ਭਵਰੁ ਬੇਲੀ ਰਾਤਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: beechaar satigur mujhai poochhiaa bhavar belee raatao ||
lines.translation: I have asked my True Guru for understanding about the bumble bee, who is so involved with the flowers of the garden.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਚੜਿਆ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪੜਿਆ ਤੇਲੁ ਤਾਵਣਿ ਤਾਤਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: sooraj chaRiaa pi(n)d paRiaa tel taavan taatao ||
lines.translation: When the sun rises, the body will fall, and it will be cooked in hot oil.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਮਗਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਖਾਹਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੇਤਾਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jam mag baadhaa khaahi chotaa sabad bin betaaliaa ||
lines.translation: You shall be bound and beaten on the road of Death, without the Word of the Shabad, O madman.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਚੇਤਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਰਹਿ ਭਵਰਾ ਕਾਲਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sach kahai naanak chet re man marahi bhavaraa kaaliaa ||2||
lines.translation: Nanak speaks the Truth. Reflect upon it, O mind; you shall die, O bumble bee. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅੜਿਆ ਪਰਦੇਸੀਆ ਕਿਤੁ ਪਵਹਿ ਜੰਜਾਲੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere jeeaRiaa paradeseeaa kit pavahi ja(n)jaale raam ||
lines.translation: O my stranger soul, why do you fall into entanglements?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਹਿ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: saachaa saahib man vasai kee phaasahi jam jaale raam ||
lines.translation: The True Lord abides within your mind; why are you trapped by the noose of Death?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਛੁਲੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀ ਨੈਣ ਰੁੰਨੀ ਜਾਲੁ ਬਧਿਕਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: machhulee vichhu(n)nee nain ru(n)nee jaal badhik paaiaa ||
lines.translation: The fish leaves the water with tearful eyes, when the fisherman casts his net.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਅੰਤਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)saar maaiaa mohu meethaa a(n)t bharam chukaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The love of Maya is sweet to the world, but in the end, this delusion is dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਛੋਡਿ ਮਨਹੁ ਅੰਦੇਸਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat kar chit laai har siu chhod manahu a(n)desiaa ||
lines.translation: So perform devotional worship, link your consciousness to the Lord, and dispel anxiety from your mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਚੇਤਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਜੀਅੜਿਆ ਪਰਦੇਸੀਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sach kahai naanak chet re man jeeaRiaa paradeseeaa ||3||
lines.translation: Nanak speaks the Truth; focus your consciousness on the Lord, O my stranger soul. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦੀਆ ਵਾਹ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ਮੇਲਾ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: nadeeaa vaah vichhu(n)niaa melaa sa(n)jogee raam ||
lines.translation: The rivers and streams which separate may sometime be united again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਵਿਸੁ ਭਰੇ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: jug jug meethaa vis bhare ko jaanai jogee raam ||
lines.translation: In age after age, that which is sweet, is full of poison; how rare is the Yogi who understands this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਸਹਜਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਨਿ ਚੇਤਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: koee sahaj jaanai har pachhaanai satiguroo jin chetiaa ||
lines.translation: That rare person who centers his consciousness on the True Guru, knows intuitively and realizes the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਪਚਹਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਚੇਤਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin naam har ke bharam bhoole pachahi mugadh achetiaa ||
lines.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the thoughtless fools wander in doubt, and are ruined.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੇ ਅੰਤਿ ਧਾਹੀ ਰੁੰਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam bhagat na ridai saachaa se a(n)t dhaahee ru(n)niaa ||
lines.translation: Those whose hearts are not touched by devotional worship and the Name of the True Lord, shall weep and wail loudly in the end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: sach kahai naanak sabad saachai mel chiree vichhu(n)niaa ||4||1||5||
lines.translation: Nanak speaks the Truth; through the True Word of the Shabad, those long separated from the Lord, are united once again. ||4||1||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 chha(n)t ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Third Mehl, Chhant, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਘਰੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham ghare saachaa sohilaa saachai sabad suhaaiaa raam ||
lines.translation: Within my home, the true wedding songs of rejoicing are sung; my home is adorned with the True Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਮੇਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan pir mel bhaiaa prabh aap milaaiaa raam ||
lines.translation: The soul-bride has met her Husband Lord; God Himself has consummated this union.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh aap milaaiaa sach ma(n)n vasaaiaa kaaman sahaje maatee ||
lines.translation: God Himself has consummated this union; the soul-bride enshrines Truth within her mind, intoxicated with peaceful poise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਰਾਵੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur sabad seegaaree sach savaaree sadaa raave ra(n)g raatee ||
lines.translation: Embellished with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and beautified with Truth, she enjoys her Beloved forever, imbued with His Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਏ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap gavaae har var paae taa har ras ma(n)n vasaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Eradicating her ego, she obtains her Husband Lord, and then, the sublime essence of the Lord dwells within her mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਸਫਲਿਉ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak gur sabad savaaree saphaliu janam sabaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, fruitful and prosperous is her entire life; she is embellished with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੜੈ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojaRai kaaman bharam bhulee har var na paae raam ||
lines.translation: The soul-bride who has been led astray by duality and doubt, does not attain her Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaman gun naahee birathaa janam gavaae raam ||
lines.translation: That soul-bride has no virtue, and she wastes her life in vain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਇਆਣੀ ਅਉਗਣਵੰਤੀ ਝੂਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: birathaa janam gavaae manamukh iaanee auganava(n)tee jhoore ||
lines.translation: The self-willed, ignorant and disgraceful manmukh wastes her life in vain, and in the end, she comes to grief.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਦੂਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapanaa satigur sev sadaa sukh paaiaa taa pir miliaa hadoore ||
lines.translation: But when she serves her True Guru, she obtains peace, and then she meets her Husband Lord, face to face.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਵਿਗਸੀ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਸਰਸੀ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: dekh pir vigasee a(n)darahu sarasee sachai sabad subhaae ||
lines.translation: Beholding her Husband Lord, she blossoms forth; her heart is delighted, and she is beautified by the True Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak vin naavai kaaman bharam bhulaanee mil preetam sukh paae ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without the Name, the soul-bride wanders around, deluded by doubt. Meeting her Beloved, she obtains peace. ||2||
